Hints for floor markings at the skyport
The desk wrote this for families

Companion Animal Travel Desk floor markings

Use the floor markings to keep the check-in path clear and calm. They show where to stand, where to wait, and where the pet handling area begins. Follow them as soon as you enter the skyport so the flow stays smooth for you and your animal.

If you are traveling with a large dog, bring the required health paperwork and keep it easy to reach. <<FACT F081>> Stay with the markings until a desk agent checks your documents and gives the next step. Do not cross into the staff lane unless someone on the floor tells you to move.

For families with a young traveler and a pet, the markings help everyone separate into the right line without confusion. <<FACT F075>> If your pet looks uneasy, slow down and let the welfare coordinator know right away. The cabin team watches animals during flight, and the shift lead can flag a case when a passenger is worried.

At the skyport, colored strips and arrow signs also guide you toward the crate check, the relief stop, and the pickup point. Keep the leash short, keep carriers closed, and keep children beside you so the route stays safe. If Harley or another pet needs a pause, ask before stepping off the marked path.

If you still need help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for the next clear instruction.
